datasets.name: migration_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) as total_migrations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT source) as unique_sources,
  COUNT(DISTINCT source_table) as unique_source_tables,
  COUNT(DISTINCT target_table) as unique_target_tables,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_migrations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) != 'SUCCESS' OR status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_migrations
FROM (
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, status, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, status, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, status, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, status, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, status, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, status, timestamp
    FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_snowflake
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
) combined_data

datasets.name: migration_trends
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE(timestamp) as migration_date,
  COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown') as load_type,
  UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN'))) as status,
  COUNT(*) as migration_count
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp, load_type, status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, load_type, status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, load_type, status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, load_type, status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, load_type, status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, load_type, status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_snowflake
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
) combined_data
GROUP BY DATE(timestamp), COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown'), UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN')))
ORDER BY migration_date

datasets.name: migration_details
queryLines:
SELECT
  source,
  source_table,
  target_table,
  COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown') as load_type,
  UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN'))) as status,
  error_message,
  timestamp
FROM (
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, load_type, status, error_message, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_status_filter = 'ALL' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN'))) = :param_status_filter)
    AND (:param_load_type_filter = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown') = :param_load_type_filter)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, load_type, status, error_message, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_status_filter = 'ALL' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN'))) = :param_status_filter)
    AND (:param_load_type_filter = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown') = :param_load_type_filter)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, load_type, status, error_message, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_status_filter = 'ALL' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN'))) = :param_status_filter)
    AND (:param_load_type_filter = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown') = :param_load_type_filter)
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, load_type, status, error_message, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_status_filter = 'ALL' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN'))) = :param_status_filter)
    AND (:param_load_type_filter = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown') = :param_load_type_filter)
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, load_type, status, error_message, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_status_filter = 'ALL' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN'))) = :param_status_filter)
    AND (:param_load_type_filter = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown') = :param_load_type_filter)
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_table, target_table, load_type, status, error_message, timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_snowflake
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_status_filter = 'ALL' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN'))) = :param_status_filter)
    AND (:param_load_type_filter = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown') = :param_load_type_filter)
 ) combined_data
ORDER BY timestamp DESC

datasets.name: load_type_performance
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown') as load_type,
  COUNT(*) as total_loads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_loads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) != 'SUCCESS' OR status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_loads,
  CASE 
    WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2)
    ELSE 0 
  END as success_rate
FROM (
  SELECT load_type, status, timestamp FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT load_type, status, timestamp FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT load_type, status, timestamp FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
  SELECT load_type, status, timestamp FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
  SELECT load_type, status, timestamp FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
  SELECT load_type, status, timestamp FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_snowflake
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
) combined_data
GROUP BY COALESCE(load_type, 'Unknown')
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY total_loads DESC

datasets.name: status_filter_options
queryLines:
SELECT 'ALL' as status_option
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN'))) as status_option
FROM (
  SELECT status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mysql
  WHERE :param_database_type = 'mysql' AND (status IS NOT NULL OR status IS NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_redshift
  WHERE :param_database_type = 'redshift' AND (status IS NOT NULL OR status IS NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_pgsql
  WHERE :param_database_type = 'postgres_sql' AND (status IS NOT NULL OR status IS NULL)
 UNION ALL
  SELECT status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_bigquery
  WHERE :param_database_type = 'bigquery' AND (status IS NOT NULL OR status IS NULL)
 UNION ALL
  SELECT status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_mssql
  WHERE :param_database_type = 'mssql' AND (status IS NOT NULL OR status IS NULL)
 UNION ALL
  SELECT status FROM migration_catalog.logging.migration_log_snowflake
  WHERE :param_database_type = 'snowflake' AND (status IS NOT NULL OR status IS NULL)
) combined_statuses
ORDER BY status_option
